# EMBER & SAGE

> EMBER & SAGE is a contemporary restaurant in Portland, OR, focused on beautifully presented food, warm hospitality, and a refined dining experience. Founded in 2018 by Chef Marcus Bellini.

## About

A contemporary restaurant where fire meets flavor. Every dish tells a story of passion, precision, and the finest ingredients. Our name reflects the dual elements that define our cooking — the primal warmth of fire and the refined elegance of fresh herbs.

## Chef

Chef Marcus Bellini — Executive Chef & Co-Founder. With over two decades of experience in Michelin-starred kitchens across Europe and North America. Born in Milan, trained in Paris, with stints in New York and Tokyo.
